subject: english
title: Final Test App — Units 1 to 9
subtitle: Whole-level final · the ExamView L4U1–9 test · 13 parts · 49 questions · 80 points · no right/wrong shown while answering

content: Answer the two listening sections: match nine photos from TR 9.5, then complete the soccer and baseball table from TR 9.6.
Use the vocabulary of the whole level — hobbies, health, relatives, inventions and the environment — in matching and in complete sentences.
Read 'Our Amazing Bodies' and 'The Twilight Zone' and answer with true/false, multiple choice and complete sentences.
Write 3 to 4 sentences comparing dolphins and sharks or reviewing a favourite book, and answer the ten speaking prompts about travel.
language: Compare with older, more difficult, better and the funniest.
Describe a person with who and a thing with which.
Say what people used to do, and what you have to and should do.
Link two changes with the double comparative the longer… the more…
